verdict.rationale: Docs confirm automatic grouping by exception type, class name, method name, and stack trace location, plus a manual ignore/status workflow (time period, occurrence count, custom rule) that lets users override default handling. However, there's no explicit documentation of directly re-grouping or merging/splitting mis-grouped errors (custom fingerprinting rules), and no independent/hands-on evidence confirming grouping accuracy at scale. Missing for 10: explicit re-grouping/merge-split controls for mis-fingerprinted errors, and independent verification of grouping quality at scale.
